mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter indicates strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 shows a significant increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous month indicates increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO shows a significant increase.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals deflationary pressure, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong economic growth and a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 quarter
regime_hint: economic expansion with tightening labor market
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met.
